discrepancies.detail: InvestEU programme page states €26.2bn; Regulation (EU) 2025/2005 (OJ 23 Dec 2025) raises the EU compartment guarantee to about €29.05bn. The framework record uses €29.05bn; the public-capital table keeps the €26.2bn programme figure as stated on its page.
€95.5bn at adoption; the official programme page now states €93.5bn after the MFF mid-term review. €93.5bn is used.
Accelerator page and Work Programme 2027 state €1M–€10M; the EIC 'Funding opportunities 2027' page states €0.5M–€10M. €1M–€10M is used.
Programme page: over €8.1bn; Commission Q&A: €7.9bn (2021 prices); EUR-Lex summary: over €7.5bn (2021 prices). €8.1bn (current prices) is used.
The Chips Act policy page gives both €525m and €500m for chip design support announced on 4 Nov 2026.
The EIC page describes €5bn as a target; the Brussels Times reports €5bn 'in commitments'. Target is used; first-closing date not confirmed.
Official figure: €397bn mobilised to end-2025; a secondary write-up of a June 2026 announcement cites €400bn. Only the official figure is used.
The 2025 Strategy names a 'European Innovation Investment Pact'; it launched on 22 Sep 2026 as the 'European Institutional Investors Pact (EIIP)'.
The Chips JU site still labels the July 2026 calls 'Open' although all deadlines (16 Sep–27 Oct 2026) have passed; recorded as closed.
